notes.title: 📢 Turkish Language Support Added! 🎉
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45188958/e21bc6a2b11ba27ee1468f7bc34e54ec73e07ed8.png[/img]

Hello players,

We've listened to your feedback and made our game more accessible! You can now play it in Turkish. We have also fixed numerous bugs and made improvements to ensure a smoother experience.

Stay tuned for more updates and improvements in the future! Happy gaming! 🎮

notes.title: Thank You for Your Support!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45188958/3f39e6e1096a1718042c38bbdeba5a1c58d5606f.png[/img]

Hello everyone!

Our first game, Naught Nate, is finally out, and we couldn’t have done it without you! We truly appreciate everyone who played, shared feedback, and supported us throughout this journey.

We’ve carefully read all your reviews—both positive and critical—and we’re taking everything into account to improve. This was our first step, and we know there’s room to grow. Your feedback is shaping our future, and we’re committed to delivering even better experiences.

With that in mind, we’re excited to announce that we’ve started working on a new game! Armed with experience and your support, we’re aiming to create something even greater.

Stay tuned for updates, and thank you for being part of this journey with us!

– Erotales 🎮

notes.title: 🎉 Naughty Nate is Out Now! 🎉

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45188958/7e025f9f0249f7ae9051dbb488bc20c63d7dbf58.png[/img]

The big day has arrived! Naughty Nate is now available on Steam! 🚀 For the first week, enjoy a 15% launch discount!

This is our first game, and your feedback means the world to us. Please support us by leaving a review! ❤️

Step into Naughty Nate’s world now! 😏🔥

notes.title: the demo is now playable
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,
We’re thrilled to announce that the demo version of Naught Nate is officially live! Get ready to dive into Nate’s exciting, bold, and fun-filled journey. 🎮

In this demo, you’ll:

Explore the dynamics of the workplace and interact with unique characters.
Meet Dia and step into the vibrant world of cosplay.
Experience how your choices influence the story.
The demo offers a glimpse of the mechanics and atmosphere you’ll find in the full game. Your feedback is invaluable to us as we continue to improve and refine the experience.

🌟 Play the Naught Nate Demo now!
Visit our Steam page to download the demo and start exploring Nate’s world. Don’t forget to share your thoughts with us—we’d love to hear from you!

👉 Be sure to wishlist the game on Steam!
Thank you for your support, and happy gaming!
